title: Global HR Operations Associate - Contingent Workforce
description: Who We Are Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact. To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive. What You'll Do BCG’s central Contingent Workforce team, branded as Contingent IQ, supports the engagement and onboarding of contingent workers and client-facing contractors across BCG. Together with the Global HR Shared Services Center (HRSSC) function that supports the internal employee lifecycle and operations, we are enhancing every individual’s journey at BCG. The HR Operations Associate will be supporting the back-end processing of contingent worker requests. This role is responsible for coordinating and executing operational activities across onboarding, supplier registration, system processing, renewals, and offboarding, while helping ensure that requests are handled accurately, compliantly, and in a timely manner. Key role & responsibilities Daily management of operational activities supporting contingent worker and client-facing contractor onboarding Reviewing intake information to ensure requests are complete, accurate, and aligned to the correct process path Completing required activities in operational systems and tools, including supplier onboarding and requisition-related support in Coupa. Capturing, validating, and maintaining accurate supplier, contract, stakeholder, and service-related information across systems, trackers, and supporting documentation. Monitoring shared mailboxes, trackers, and operational queues to ensure timely and accurate case progression. Responding to operational queries from stakeholders and providing clear status updates on active requests. Maintaining strong data integrity across relevant systems and identifying gaps, errors, or missing information for follow-up. Maintaining personnel records in compliance with legal requirements and internal standards. Producing basic reports and responding to data or status requests from key stakeholders and supporting internal audits with required documentation and timely response. Ability to work flexible hours, as needed, to provide effective global coverage. Excellent written and spoken English communication skills. Proficiency in MS Office, especially Outlook, Excel, and PowerPoint. Experience working in a global multinational is preferred. Demonstrated integrity, professionalism, and a strong service mindset. Desirable: Basic experience with contingent workforce processes, supplier onboarding, contractor lifecycle operations, shared mailboxes, service management, Coupa, Workday, Fieldglass, or related tools. Additional info This role requires someone who thrives in a structured, matrixed global organization and can manage detail-heavy operational work while collaborating across teams: Work effectively within a global, cross-cultural, and virtual environment. Demonstrate a strong customer focus and effective stakeholder management skills. Exhibit exceptional attention to detail and a disciplined approach to operational accuracy. Communicate clearly and professionally with a range of stakeholders across teams and functions. Thriving under pressure with exceptional attention to detail. Staying flexible and reliable in a dynamic and changing environment. Handling sensitive data with confidentiality and professionalism. At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development. title: C++ Trainer
description: Job Title: Freelance Corporate Technical Trainer – Embedded C & Embedded C++ Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka (On-site at Client Premises / Hybrid – customize as needed ) Engagement Type: Freelance / Contract / Batch-based Experience: 5–12+ Years (Embedded Firmware Development & Corporate Technical Training) Role Overview We are seeking an industry-seasoned Freelance Embedded C & Embedded C++ Technical Trainer in Bengaluru to design and deliver intensive corporate upskilling programs for firmware engineers, graduate engineer trainees (GETs), and lateral hires. The trainer will bridge low-level hardware-software concepts with production-grade embedded coding practices through hands-on labs, target-board exercises, and real-world debugging scenarios . Key Responsibilities Corporate Training Delivery: Lead interactive classroom and/or live virtual bootcamps covering bare-metal Embedded C, resource-constrained Embedded C++, and RTOS fundamentals. Hands-on Hardware & Simulator Labs: Conduct practical labs on ARM Cortex-M / STM32 / ESP32 development boards (or QEMU/Renode simulators), guiding engineers through peripheral configuration, register-level programming, and real-time debugging. Curriculum & Lab Customization: Tailor slide decks, coding assignments, and mini-projects to align with client domain requirements (Automotive, IoT, Industrial Automation, or Consumer Electronics). Code Reviews & Assessments: Evaluate participant code for memory safety, determinism, and MISRA compliance; conduct pre- and post-training assessments and provide actionable skill-gap reports to L&D stakeholders. Required Technical Skills Embedded C & Low-Level Architecture: Pointers, function pointers, bitwise manipulation, volatile, const, memory-mapped I/O, and linker scripts/memory layout (stack, heap, .bss, .data, flash). Interrupt Service Routines (ISRs), NVIC, DMA, timers, and peripheral communication protocols ( UART, SPI, I2C, CAN ). Embedded C++ (Modern C++14/17/20 for Firmware): Deterministic OOP, RAII, constexpr, templates, type traits, and zero-overhead abstractions. Avoiding dynamic memory fragmentation (custom allocators, static allocation patterns, std::array, std::span, std::variant). RTOS & Concurrency: FreeRTOS or Zephyr RTOS concepts: task scheduling, mutexes, semaphores, message queues, deadlocks, and priority inversion. Toolchains & Debugging: Cross-compilation toolchains (arm-none-eabi-gcc), CMake/Makefiles, OpenOCD, GDB, JTAG/SWD debuggers, and static analysis tools. Good-to-Have Skills (Include based on client domain) Familiarity with MISRA C / MISRA C++ and AUTOSAR C++14 coding guidelines. Embedded Linux, device drivers, or Yocto build system experience. Unit testing and mocking for embedded targets (CppUTest, Google Test, Unity/CMock). Experience with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and CAN bus analyzers (CANoe/CANalyzer). Qualifications & Soft Skills Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics & Communication (ECE), Electrical Engineering (EEE), Computer Science, or Instrumentation. Minimum 5 years of hands-on embedded software/firmware development experience, with prior experience delivering corporate technical trainings. Strong ability to translate datasheet specifications and hardware constraints into clear, practical coding exercises. High professionalism, punctuality, and adaptability to corporate L&D schedules. Intrested Candidate Share your Cv to this mail:hr@eduscope.services or 8428724162 Pay: ₹1,000.00 - ₹2,000.00 per day Work Location: In person
